question: What apiVersion should I use for Ingress in v1.22?
ground_truth: networking.k8s.io/v1 — extensions/v1beta1 and networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 Ingress were removed in v1.22.

question: Is PodSecurityPolicy available in v1.25?
ground_truth: No. PodSecurityPolicy was removed in v1.25; use Pod Security Admission instead.

question: What apiVersion should CronJob use in v1.25?
ground_truth: batch/v1 — batch/v1beta1 CronJob was removed in v1.25.

question: Which API group serves CustomResourceDefinition in v1.22?
ground_truth: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 — the v1beta1 CRD API was removed in v1.22.

question: Is the dockershim container runtime supported in v1.24?
ground_truth: No. Dockershim was removed in v1.24; use containerd or CRI-O.

question: What apiVersion does HorizontalPodAutoscaler use in v1.26?
ground_truth: autoscaling/v2 — autoscaling/v2beta2 was removed in v1.26.

question: Is the FlowSchema v1beta1 API available in v1.26?
ground_truth: flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta1 was removed in v1.26; use v1beta3 or later.

question: What admission control replaces PSP for enforcing pod security in v1.25?
ground_truth: Pod Security Admission (PSA), stable in v1.25, using namespace labels with privileged/baseline/restricted levels.

question: Which apiVersion serves EndpointSlice in v1.25?
ground_truth: discovery.k8s.io/v1 — the v1beta1 EndpointSlice API was removed in v1.25.

question: Are in-tree GlusterFS volumes supported in v1.26?
ground_truth: The GlusterFS in-tree plugin was deprecated; removal landed in v1.26.

question: What is the status of the events.k8s.io/v1beta1 API in v1.25?
ground_truth: Removed in v1.25; use events.k8s.io/v1.

question: Is seccomp profile defaulting GA in v1.27?
ground_truth: SeccompDefault graduated to stable in v1.27.

question: Which apiVersion should PodDisruptionBudget use in v1.25?
ground_truth: policy/v1 — policy/v1beta1 PDB was removed in v1.25.

question: Is the in-tree AWS EBS volume plugin available in v1.27?
ground_truth: CSI migration for AWS EBS is complete; the in-tree plugin is deprecated in favor of the EBS CSI driver.

question: Does kubectl support the --short flag for version in v1.28?
ground_truth: kubectl version --short was removed in v1.28; short output is now default.

question: What is the storage version for batch/v1beta1 CronJob in v1.21?
ground_truth: In v1.21 CronJob graduated to batch/v1; v1beta1 still served but deprecated.

question: Is the RuntimeClass scheduling API in node.k8s.io/v1beta1 available in v1.25?
ground_truth: node.k8s.io/v1beta1 RuntimeClass was removed in v1.25; use node.k8s.io/v1.

question: Are wildcard queries to the apiserver via apiVersion extensions/v1beta1 valid in v1.22?
ground_truth: extensions/v1beta1 was fully removed by v1.22 — all workloads APIs moved to apps/v1 and networking.k8s.io/v1.

question: Is CSIStorageCapacity beta API available in v1.27?
ground_truth: storage.k8s.io/v1beta1 CSIStorageCapacity was removed in v1.27; use storage.k8s.io/v1.

question: What replaces the deprecated --pod-eviction-timeout flag in v1.27?
ground_truth: Taint-based eviction with tolerationSeconds replaces the controller-manager --pod-eviction-timeout behavior.
